subject: Exec briefing + sponsor cover for SunGrid demo
messages:
From: Lisa Carter <lisa.carter@sungrid.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Decker <alex.decker@sungrid.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: Intro + exec presence for next-week demo

Hi Naomi / Marcus —

Thanks again for the overview last week. We want to move from discovery to a focused technical briefing for our execs (Alex, CIO) and the VP of Platform (I'm looping in Alex). Ideally we'd get a 30–45 minute executive-focused demo next week that covers: high-level architecture, deployment options (VPC vs Dedicated), and a short Q&A focused on compliance and SLAs.

Alex is on travel the first half of next week but can be available Thurs/Fri morning CST. Our preferred slots: Thu 11/4 9:00–9:45 CST or Fri 11/5 10:00–10:45 CST. If those don't work, can the VP at Redwood stand in for the CTO/CIO briefing? We need someone who can speak to capacity, SLAs, and customer risk.

I've attached the SOW stub so you have context (SunGrid_SOW_v1.pdf).

Best,
Lisa
——
Lisa Carter
Head of Platform Strategy | SunGrid
Attachments: SunGrid_SOW_v1.pdf
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Carter <lisa.carter@sungrid.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Intro + exec presence for next-week demo

Thanks Lisa — great to see the SOW, and that timeline makes sense.

Short answer: yes, we can arrange an executive-level briefing. Marcus (cc'd) is our engagement lead for SunGrid and will propose a final agenda. Stephanie will be our technical lead on the demo and can cover deployment and SLAs. If Alex is only available Thursday/Friday morning CST, we should hold one of those windows and also nominate a VP-level backup on our side in case Alex's travel overlaps the slot.

Marcus — can you confirm whether 11/4 9:00 CST or 11/5 10:00 CST works for your internal execs? If neither, suggest two fallback slots the following week.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Lisa Carter <lisa.carter@sungrid.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 13:40:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Intro + exec presence for next-week demo

Lisa / Naomi —

Thanks — quick update on our side: 11/4 9:00 CST is tight for our CTO, but 11/5 10:00 CST works cleanly for both Naomi and our VP of Sales (Aditya Rao) who can cover executive-level questions on contracts/SLA tradeoffs. Stephanie and I will lead the technical portion.

Question: would SunGrid prefer a 30-minute tightly focused demo or a 60-minute session where we leave time for deeper compliance discussion (SOC 2, data residency, audit logs)? We can do either; my recommendation is 45 minutes (25 demo + 20 targeted Q&A).

I've attached the latest demo deck we'll use internally (redwood-demo-deck-v2.pdf) — we can trim slides for an exec audience.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-demo-deck-v2.pdf
From: Lisa Carter <lisa.carter@sungrid.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Decker <alex.decker@sungrid.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Intro + exec presence for next-week demo

Hi Marcus / Naomi —

Thanks for the options. Quick update: Alex is now confirmed to be available Fri 11/5 10:00–10:45 CST, but he asked if we could keep it to 30 minutes — tight travel schedule. He wants a concise exec-level view and then a nod to follow-up deep-dive with the technical team. If Aditya can stand in for policy/contract questions, that would be perfect.

We also have a short internal pre-brief on Friday morning at 8:00 CST; if you could send a calendar invite with the 30-minute slot and a one-line agenda, that will help.

One ask: can Redwood share a one-page SLA summary and a pointer to the audit artifacts we offer (SOC 2 + retention controls) before the meeting? That will help Alex prepare.

Best,
Lisa
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Carter <lisa.carter@sungrid.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0500
Subject: Confirm: Fri 11/5 10:00–10:30 CST — SunGrid exec briefing

Lisa / Alex —

Confirmed: we've booked Fri, Nov 5, 2026 10:00–10:30 AM CST for the executive briefing. Calendar invite sent (see link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/7f3b-sungrid-demo). Agenda (one-liner included in invite): 1) High-level platform & deployment options (10m) 2) SLA / compliance summary (10m) 3) Next steps & follow-ups (10m).

Aditya will cover contract/SLA tradeoffs and act as our exec backup if Naomi or Marcus need to step out. Stephanie will start with a 10-minute executive demo focused on architecture and isolation modes.

Attached: 1-page SLA summary (SLA_summary_SunGrid.pdf) and links to our SOC 2 overview + retention docs. We'll also post the full demo deck to the invite notes after the call.

If anything changes, flag it here and we'll adjust quickly. Looking forward to it.

—
Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
Attachments: SLA_summary_SunGrid.pdf
